title: Hume Center funded by former CIA S&T officer Ted Hume

plain: The Hume Center at Virginia Tech in Blacksburg, Virginia, was funded by Ted Hume, a former science and technology officer at the CIA, the US foreign intelligence agency, and his wife. That is what a researcher named Bob McGwier, who worked with the CIA as a contractor, says: Hume left the agency, started a company that did well, sold it, and put some of the money back into the center.
